tools.name: search_bouquets
tools.description: List the bouquets for sale, with price in US dollars, photo and page link. Filter by occasion, colour, budget or words. Every bouquet is made by hand by a florist in Tel Aviv.

tools.name: get_bouquet
tools.description: Everything about one bouquet: description, flowers, colours, occasions, price, all photos.

tools.name: delivery_options
tools.description: Where and when we deliver: the cities, the delivery price, the next delivery dates with any day surcharge, and the rules (no Shabbat or Jewish festival days, 11:00-19:00 Israel time). Pass a date to check that day.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: The exact total for a bouquet delivered to a city on a date, with any coupon, before placing the order.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Place an order and get its payment link. The order is held but not taken until the person pays at that link (card, in US dollars, on AllPay's secure page); give them the link and the total. Never pay on their behalf unless they asked you to and gave you the means. Confirm the recipient, address, pho

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: The status of an order (awaiting payment, paid, delivered, cancelled), by order number and the buyer's email.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order · Public sink: order_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order · Public sink: order_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
